notes_for_editor: Checked tnlandforms (2,319 ft, state 3-10, standing), the Forest Lookouts Tennessee index (Division of Forestry District 3), the 2014 extant-tower table in the NPS-hosted Division of Forestry document, and a 2024 Compass sale listing. Nothing found on build date, design, staffing or fires. The sale listing's description never mentions the tower (its headline repeats the road name, Fire-Tower Road), so it is not evidence of who owns the tower. A Land and Farm listing returned HTTP 403. Record elevation 706.8 m matches 2,319 ft. The tower is not on the NHLR Tennessee list in the crawl.
